fact_card_packet.title: SEC roundtable: November 9
fact_card_packet.question: When is the announced roundtable, how can readers follow it, and what is its stated subject?

rows.label: Scheduled date
rows.support_excerpt: The Securities and Exchange Commission announced today that it will host a roundtable on November 9, 2026, to discuss the use of machine-understandable data and Super Intelligence (SI) and related risks and costs.

rows.label: Webcast
rows.value: The discussion will be streamed live on SEC.gov
rows.support_excerpt: The discussion will be streamed live on SEC.gov, and a recording will be available at a later date.

rows.support_excerpt: to discuss the use of machine-understandable data and Super Intelligence (SI) and related risks and costs.

caption: The SEC's October 19 announcement schedules a public roundtable for November 9. The stated discussion concerns machine-understandable data, Super Intelligence and associated risks and costs.
alt_text: SEC roundtable facts: November 9, 2026, 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. EST, at SEC headquarters in Washington, D.C., with public access and a live stream on SEC.gov. The announced topic is machine-understandable data, Super Intelligence, and related risks and costs.
